excerpt.zh: 我们的消费品赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
excerpt.en: Our consumer goods deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

texts.zh: 我们的消费品赤字已经失控了！我们需要开源节流，否则将面临更严重的惩罚。
texts.en: Our consumer goods deficit is out of control! We will have to cut back on our expenditures or increase our income, failing which we will face ever bigger penalties.

texts.zh: 消费品的短缺导致[Root.Owner.GetName]境内生活水平的严重下滑。不满的声音日益显现，采取紧急行动的呼吁越来越广泛，很明显，供应的完全崩溃只有数月之遥了。
texts.en: The shortages of consumer goods have led to a precipitous drop in living standards within the [Root.Owner.GetName]. Voices of discontent are growing ever stronger, and urgent calls to action are increasingly widespread as it becomes clear that a total breakdown in supplies is only months away.

texts.zh: 消费品的短缺导致了[Root.Owner.GetName]内非格式塔生物的生活水平大幅下跌。不满的声音日益显现，采取紧急行动的呼吁越来越广泛，很明显，供应的完全崩溃只有数月之遥了。
texts.en: Shortages of consumer goods have led to a precipitous drop in living standards for the individualistic life forms living within the [Root.Owner.GetName]. Voices of discontent are growing ever stronger, as our logistics drones warn that a total breakdown in supplies is only months away.

label.zh: 我们可以从支持者那里借一点。
label.en: We can borrow from our supporters.

label.zh: 我们得勒紧裤腰带了，制定配给制度。
label.en: Hard times are upon us. Institute rationing.
Everything is going according to plan.

texts.zh: 我们的消费品短缺已经严重到没有任何切合实际的办法能够弥补。大幅削减将会强制执行，我们将别无选择接受破产并重组我们的契约。
texts.en: Consumer goods shortages have increased to the point that there is no realistic way our deficits can be recouped. Sharp cutbacks will be enforced, as we have no choice but to accept bankruptcy and default on our obligations.
